name: SPT-CL J0319-2244 (Webb)
blurb: SPT-CL J0319-2244, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Webb.
label: sptclj03192244-webb
story: A rich cluster of galaxies, one of the massive clusters in a Webb survey that maps their dark matter through strong lensing and tracks how they grow over cosmic time.

claims.text: SPT-CLJ0319-2244 is a target of JWST program 5594 (SLICE), a NIRCam survey of 182 massive galaxy clusters, described as a rich cluster
SLICE tracks the evolution of the luminous and dark components of galaxy clusters, with dark matter measured mainly through strong-lensing modeling
